subject: Exec handshake + technical deep-dive — locking next steps to unblock pilot
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@acmeadtech.com>, Priya Singh <priya@retailedge.io>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Exec handshake + technical deep-dive — locking next steps to unblock pilot

Hi Tom / Priya — great call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock dates and keep momentum: 

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: validate integration approach and confirm capacity/pricing to unblock a 6-week pilot.
- Key risks you called out: data-retention requirements, KV-cache persistence across warm restarts, and throughput at 50 qps with 512 tokens avg.

Suggested next meetings to move forward:
1) Executive handshake (VP / CTO intro) — 30 min. Objective: align success criteria, procurement timeline, and executive sponsorship.
2) Technical deep-dive (infrastructure + infra runbook) — 90 min. Objective: detailed architecture map, integration points, and pilot SLOs.

Proposed windows (rough) — please confirm what works for you and your CTO: 
- Exec handshake: Wed 9 Dec, 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 10 Dec, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Tech deep-dive: Thu 10 Dec, 09:00–10:30 PT or Fri 11 Dec, 08:00–09:30 PT

I attached a one-page discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan so we can populate owners once dates are locked. If you prefer, I can share calendar invites for the two windows above.

Attendees I’d propose:
- Exec handshake: Tom Li, Priya Singh, Michael Park (CTO) + Diego Fernandez (Redwood), Karthik Iyer (Redwood sales lead)
- Tech deep-dive: Michael Park, Eng lead (your side), Diego Fernandez, Karthik Iyer, Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer)

Next step: reply with which pair of slots work and whether Michael can join the exec handshake (or suggest an alternate time).

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[email] diego.fernandez@redwood.com | [m] (415) 555-0193
[attachment: discovery-notes-20261201.pdf] [attachment: mutual-action-plan-ACME.xlsx]

From: Tom Li <tom.li@acmeadtech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya@retailedge.io>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:10:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec handshake + technical deep-dive — locking next steps to unblock pilot

Thanks Diego — good summary. 

I can do an exec handshake and will loop in our CTO Michael Park. Our immediate availability: 
- Tue 8 Dec: mornings (8:30–11:30 PT)
- Wed 9 Dec: 09:30–11:00 PT (best)

For the tech deep-dive the engineering team prefers 90–120 min slots; Thu 10 Dec mornings also look OK for us.

Agenda request for exec handshake:
- 10 min intros and success metrics
- 10 min pilot scope / timeline and SLAs
- 10 min commercialization / pricing guardrails

Looping Michael on this thread (cc'd). Michael — can you confirm Wed 9 Dec 10:00 PT? If that works we'll ask Diego to send a 30-min invite and block the tech deep-dive separately.

On a logistics note: please include any minimum throughput guarantees you can offer in the MAP so procurement can see it.

Cheers,
Tom
Director of Product, Acme AdTech
Tom Li <tom.li@acmeadtech.com>

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@acmeadtech.com>, Priya Singh <priya@retailedge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 18:22:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec handshake + technical deep-dive — locking next steps to unblock pilot

Perfect — appreciate the quick reply and the agenda guidance. Locking these provisional slots and dropping invites now: 

1) Exec handshake — Wed, 9 Dec 2026, 10:00–10:30 PT (30m) — invite sent
   - Attendees: Tom Li, Priya Singh, Michael Park; Diego Fernandez, Karthik Iyer
   - Draft agenda: intros + success metrics / pilot timeline / procurement ask (I’ll keep to the 10/10/10 split Tom suggested)

2) Tech deep-dive — Thu, 10 Dec 2026, 09:00–10:30 PT (90m) — invite sent
   - Attendees: Michael Park, Eng lead (Acme), Diego Fernandez, Karthik Iyer, Marissa Cole
   - Draft agenda: architecture overview (30m), integration checklist & auth flows (30m), perf/scale runbook & pilot gating (30m)

I attached an updated MAP that includes a minimum throughput table (50 qps baseline, 75 qps burst), and a short SLA excerpt for pilot negotiations. Karthik / Marissa — FYI please come prepared to talk deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) and warm start KV-cache behavior. Marissa — would you bring the infra runbook template?

If anyone needs different times I can reopen slots — otherwise I’ll leave the invites as-is and we can finalize later this week.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Diego
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: mutual-action-plan-ACME.xlsx] [attachment: sla-excerpt-pilot.pdf]
